unit.drivingQuestion: Which dimensions and records justify a volume/capacity claim? KICD: Why is the knowledge of volume and capacity useful?
unit.storylineThread: Units → cone/cylinder → pyramid → conefrustum → actualmeasure → pyramidfrustum → actualcone/pyramidmodels → actualfrustummodels → actualdocumentation → usablefill → audit → independent evidence.
unit.content: Volume and capacity (cone, pyramid, frustum); Application of volumes of pyramids and frustums.
unit.coreCompetencies:
Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: the learner acquires open-mindedness and creativity skills when discussing with peers and working out the volume and capacity of the containers.
Creativity and Imagination: The learner develops connection or networking skills when working out the volumes of frustums from cones and pyramids.
unit.values:
Unity: the learner displays tolerance of different opinions while working with peers when models of frustums as a learning resource.
Respect: the learner listens to others’ opinions while discussing appropriate formulas for working out volume and capacity of containers.
unit.pcis: Environment and technology: the learner uses appropriate containers from the local environment to work out the capacity of cones, pyramids, and their frustum.
